# Compound Engineering integration — Lean V7.2 eight-pass audit

## Summary

Inspected source: `EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin` at commit `871996c4e35512e3d33cdc9c2532395f7bf10831`, release `3.23.3`.

Decision: absorb selected mechanics; do not install the full competing lifecycle beside Lean. V7.2 keeps 30 routed skills, adds no external integration, and changes seven existing authorities.

## Material additions

- `plan`: Direct, Brief, and Durable output depth; stable identifiers; settled decisions; plans as guardrails rather than implementation choreography.
- `skill-design`: outcome spine; invariant/default/heuristic classification; live cross-host topology cells; identical-build noise-floor measurement.
- `project-context`: verified solution-learning mode with overlap checks and exactly one durable sink.
- `review`: severity remains separate from repair class; cross-model identity receipts; live delegation evidence.
- `gauntlet-loop`: critic/judge identity receipts and live-topology evidence.
- `experiment`: degenerate gates and a staged stability ladder for expensive or noisy scoring.
- `get-it-done`: every accepted residual issue needs a durable sink and revisit ownership before `DONE`.

## Explicit rejections

- No CE skill names or lifecycle aliases were imported.
- No `lfg`-style autonomous push or PR workflow was added.
- No automatic cross-provider review was added.
- No phrase-triggered trusted learning or automatic instruction mutation was added.
- No Proof, Riffrec, product-pulse, promotion, or connector-specific runtime was added.

## Size impact

- Skills: 30 → 30
- Primary `SKILL.md` lines: 753 → 762
- Primary `SKILL.md` words: 9524 → 9684
- Largest primary skill: 67 → 67 lines
- Net words added across all changed neutral runtime documents: 348
- New routed skills: 0

## Eight passes

| Pass | Focus | Result |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Source revision, license, package surfaces, and 33-skill accounting | PASS |
| 2 | Trigger overlap and consolidation architecture | PASS |
| 3 | Outcome, planning, learning, review, experiment, and completion semantics | PASS |
| 4 | Cross-host identity, live-topology evidence, and false-independence protection | PASS |
| 5 | Trusted-state, privacy, mutation, and consequential-action boundaries | PASS |
| 6 | Context economy, word budget, and no new routed skills | PASS |
| 7 | Profile consistency, OpenAI adapters, and OMP-neutral `SKILL.md` bodies | PASS |
| 8 | Deterministic ZIPs, checksums, extraction, path safety, and reproducibility | PASS |

## Remaining limitations

Static validation cannot prove identical model routing across OMP, Codex CLI, and ChatGPT desktop. Live cross-host evaluation must be run by the installed host when the behavior matters. A model-family receipt is available only when the host exposes reliable identity evidence; otherwise independence remains reduced.
